firstPlayerRule: Whoever traveled most recently takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the Totem Connection Scoring Marker, which also serves as the first-player token. Turns proceed clockwise.
An optional setup rule for later games starts the initial hand draft with the last player. It does not change who takes the first gameplay turn.
With two players, each person also plays for a shared third tribe after their own action; this does not replace the starting-player criterion.
